title: The change request body a pr-author turn answers with
description: The structured answer `oneharness.pr-author.toml` validates every drafting turn against, and the whole contract between this repository's drafter and `onepipeline`, which reads the drafted body out of `results[].structured.body` of the retained member report. One required field, and nothing beside it: a drafter that answered with a `title`, a `summary`, or its own commentary would have that extra silently ignored downstream, so the schema refuses it here — where oneharness re-prompts, up to `schema_max_retries` — rather than downstream where nothing is watching.

body.description: The change request body, in whatever shape the drafting task asked for — that task is the one place the shape is stated, so it is not restated here. Markdown, not JSON-escaped prose: `onevcs` opens the change request with exactly these characters.
